purpose: Close the pinned served action observer over legitimate behavior before one fresh Stage-D support successor; do not redefine topology eligibility, informativeness, or scientific outcomes.

authorization.basis: The user explicitly authorized a revised bounded-repair policy after v10: demonstrated outcome-independent environment or integration defects may terminate compute, be repaired, and use fresh addresses rather than terminating the entire research question.
authorization.next_required_document: A separate hash-bound v11 live preregistration and audit after this CPU hardening passes independent review.

pinned_action_model.scope: The pinned Qwen/Renderers/Verifiers/vLLM stack only; this is not a generic OpenAI response contract.
completed_actions: finish_reason=stop with nonempty exact sampled tokens/logprobs ending in the signed EOS token
finish_reason=length with nonempty exact sampled tokens/logprobs whose length equals max_tokens
finish_reason=tool_calls with nonempty exact sampled tokens/logprobs and renderer-validated tool-call semantics
ordinary sampled assistant text including a textual refusal, whether parse-valid or parse-malformed, when exact token and transport evidence is complete
pinned_action_model.ordinary_topology_negative: A completed exact action or episode whose causal topology, restorability, replayability, or informativeness fails the frozen selector/finalizer law. It stays in the denominator and is not retried.
terminal_invariants: unknown finish reason or provider-only refusal/content-filter outcome outside the pinned contract
missing or ambiguous raw response bytes
semantic tool-schema differences after canonical normalization
provenance mismatch, duplicate structural address, ledger inconsistency, or response delivery ambiguity
pinned_action_model.multi_call_closure: Multi-turn children, returning roots, compaction calls, and concurrent siblings are captured under the same action law. Eligibility is decided only after exact capture by the ordinary source finalizer.

retry_watchdog.behavior: Retire the rollout, preserve the original failing handler long enough to record its cause, cancel and await sibling work, reject later requests, and never issue a second model POST for the failed action.

historical_corpus.honesty_rule: Never synthesize raw cassettes for v1-v3 or v5-v6. V4 is raw-response/ledger evidence. Only v7-v10 contain reloadable completed BehaviorAction envelopes; the historical audit proves canonical hashes, receipt linkage, action/key digests, and termination closure but does not replay renderer semantics.
historical_corpus.scratch_rule: Historical evidence is read-only; every regression that mutates lifecycle state uses a fresh scratch ledger.

support_density_inventory.fewshot_precursor: The historical 8/64 result was a pre-SFT few-shot precursor and is not an estimate for the selected Stage-D adapter.
support_density_inventory.post_sft_natural_evidence: Only a few partial, adaptively selected rollouts exist. They establish natural root/child calls but not an unbiased 64-paper joint-support rate.
support_density_inventory.eligible_target_density: Partially observed and not estimable as a confirmatory population probability from retained data.
support_density_inventory.branch_informativeness: Not observed on a natural post-SFT support cohort because no natural branch continuations completed.
support_density_inventory.joint_eligible_and_informative_probabili: Not identifiable; no binomial projection or pass probability is authorized before fresh support measurement.

nested_counts.N_scaffold: rollouts containing the two predeclared first-turn child calls
nested_counts.N_eligible: rollouts containing a pre-action-committed target that is exactly restorable and replayable
nested_counts.N_joint: rollouts counted by N_eligible whose planned-K branch group is reward-informative

failure_taxonomy: N_joint >= 58: support pass; freeze a separate scientific campaign

two_attempt_limit.attempt_one: One fresh-address successor under a fully frozen live preregistration.
two_attempt_limit.attempt_two: At most one fresh-address repair successor, only after a demonstrated outcome-independent integration or infrastructure defect and a committed repair-only amendment.
two_attempt_limit.untouched_address_rule: A failure before any response bytes may preserve untouched addresses. Any address with observed response bytes is permanently retired.
two_attempt_limit.forbidden_between_attempts: No model, adapter, scaffold, dataset law, sampler, token budget, selector, K, threshold, metric, scientific arm, or decision-rule change.
terminal_events: a completed support pass or support fail
any attempt to rerun an observed address

sft_policy.possible_future_sft: Only after a new design review, as one predeclared format/scaffold-only candidate with no search, no task/reward supervision, and a fresh held-out support cohort.
sft_policy.stage_d_stop: A genuine topology/restorability or informativeness shortfall ends this Stage-D design rather than triggering gate tuning.

required_cpu_exit_checks: textual refusal is retained as ordinary sampled content
historical corpus hashes, ledger chains, receipt positions, evidence references, archives, and cryptographic completed-action envelopes pass without claiming historical renderer-semantic replay
fail-fast Verifiers patch applies after the frozen v10 patch stack
observed failure returns non-retryable 409, preserves its cause, cancels siblings, and issues no second POST
legacy v10 dependency manifests remain parseable while future manifests require the fail-fast patch
independent adversarial and code-quality reviews pass
